design_philosophy.visual_style: Tactical Minimalism. Sharp edges, high contrast, dense information density, trusted colors.
design_philosophy.theme_strategy: Light Mode default for Admin/Management. Sidebar is always Dark (#0F172A).
universal_rules: No soft/diffuse shadows; use crisp borders.
Interactive elements must have clear hover states.
Use data-testid attributes on ALL interactive elements.

font_family.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

usage_rules.headings: font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900. H1: text-3xl/tight, H2: text-2xl/tight

primary.description: The core brand color. Used for Sidebar, Primary Buttons, Active States.

secondary.description: Used for secondary buttons, muted backgrounds.

accent.description: Dynamic organization color. Defaults to Blue-500 if not set.

containers.sidebar: bg-[#0F172A] text-slate-300 w-64 fixed h-full z-30
containers.header: h-16 border-b border-slate-200 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-20

button.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-sm h-10 px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:opacity-50
button.secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 shadow-sm h-10 px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors
button.ghost: hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900 h-10 px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors
button.destructive: bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700 shadow-sm h-10 px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors

input.base: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-slate-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/20 focus-visible:border-primary disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50
input.label: text-sm font-medium leading-none peer-disabled:cursor-not-allowed peer-disabled:opacity-70 mb-2 block

card.wrapper: rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-950 shadow-sm
card.title: text-lg font-semibold leading-none tracking-tight

login_background.description: Use this image for the right-side panel of the login page. Apply a slight dark overlay (bg-slate-900/20) to ensure text legibility if text is placed over it, though usually, it's decorative.

default_logo.style: font-bold text-xl tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2

branding_strategy.instructions: Implement dynamic branding by applying CSS variables to the root or a 'theme-wrapper' div. When a user belongs to an org, inject: --org-accent-color: {org.accent_color}.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Ensure Tailwind config includes the custom colors defined in 'colors' section.
2. LOGIN PAGE: Create a split layout. Left side (40%): Login Form. Right side (60%): 'login_background' image (hidden on mobile).
3. DASHBOARD: Implement a Sidebar Layout. Sidebar fixed left (w-64, bg-primary). Header fixed top (h-16, bg-white, left-64). Main content (p-8, bg-slate-50).
4. MULTI-TENANCY: The Sidebar Logo area must display the Org Name (or Logo if available). The active accent color (buttons, links) should use the Org's accent color.
5. FORGOT PASSWORD: Create a simple centered card layout for this flow.
6. TESTING: Add 'data-testid' to: Login Button ('btn-login'), Email Input ('input-email'), Password Input ('input-password'), Forgot Password Link ('link-forgot-password').
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Input fields must have distinct :focus states.
Error messages must be red-600 and text-sm.
Success messages must be emerald-600 and text-sm.
